limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The source paper introduces pro-star-reversibility and already proves several projection consequences; those are prior work. The unit-rigidity, local and semiperfect classifications, domain criterion, and minimal F4 separation were not located in targeted searches, but equivalent observations may exist under older terminology concerning self-adjoint units, clean rings, or involution-fixed unit groups. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: A structural analysis of the recently introduced pro-star-reversible condition, using invertible projected products, local-ring unit structure, and the standard decomposition of semiperfect rings into local corners.
record_title: Pro-star reversibility collapses on semiperfect rings
